angles.label: Dermatologist-adjacent authority
angles.description: A credentialed-sounding voice explains the mechanism before showing the product.

angles.label: Ingredient-as-villain switch
angles.description: Names a common ingredient as the cause of the viewer's problem, then positions the product as the removal.

angles.label: Texture close-up ASMR
angles.description: Opens on extreme macro of product texture with no speech for the first beat.

angles.label: Routine compression
angles.description: Replaces a multi-step routine with one product; counts down the steps being dropped.

angles.label: Age-reveal reversal
angles.description: Presenter states their age after the viewer has formed an impression.

angles.label: Price-anchor demolition
angles.description: Compares against a named premium tier on cost-per-use.

angles.label: Sceptic conversion
angles.description: Presenter opens hostile to the category and narrates being wrong.

angles.label: Problem-agitation close-up
angles.description: Opens on the unretouched problem in harsh light before any product appears.

angles.label: Sold-out social proof
angles.description: Leads with scarcity and restock history as the proof point.

angles.label: Mechanism diagram
angles.description: Uses a simple drawn or animated cross-section to explain why it works.

angles.label: Gift-framing
angles.description: Reframes a self-purchase as a gift to shift the objection from cost to thoughtfulness.

angles.label: Founder direct-address
angles.description: Founder speaks to camera about a formulation decision and what it cost them.
